title: Add BuildGoal.Id property for per-goal outcome correlation
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — council finding P1-003

`BuildGoal` is missing an `Id` property — all instances share `Guid.Empty`. This means per-goal outcome correlation for the build pipeline is broken. The `ActionOutcome.GoalId` field always contains `Guid.Empty` for build-related actions, making it impossible to correlate outcomes to specific build goals.

**Recommendation:** Add a `Guid Id { get; init; } = Guid.NewGuid()` property to `BuildGoal`, matching the pattern used by other goal types.
